label: 샘방울 칼날 + 분비 + 갑각
method: Complete coherent image-generated full-body cels. Whole source-cell cropping and integer registration only. No programmatic alpha cleanup, warping, resampling, part composition, rotation, or interpolated anatomy in deliverable sheets. The last cel in return-to-neutral actions repeats the whole first cel exactly. Birth is a complete authored scene including nest, water-neck, travel and landing, not a code-composed scene.
limitations: 16 source key cels per action, rather than 60fps independently drawn frames.
Faithful generated interpretation of existing concept, not pixel-identical concept art.
Transparent generated source has extremely faint edge alpha; native alpha is preserved unchanged.
Birth contains the nest and complete world travel, and is a planning-scene clip rather than a body-only runtime sprite.
